methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $6M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Apis Cor is a seed-stage housing and construction technology company that has raised $5.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a private comparable set of five peers in the same sector—BotBuilt, Unlimited Industries, Ground Control Development, ADMARES, and Hedral—with no public company comps identified in this space. This reflects the early-stage, fragmented nature of the construction-tech segment.

The stage-progression method was applied as the primary valuation approach. Using total capital raised ($5.5M) as a proxy for base value, a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $14M. This multiplier reflects observed step-ups in the housing and construction subsector when companies progress from seed funding.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $12M to $16M, with a median of $14M. The relatively narrow band reflects reliance on a single applicable method; a wider range of data points from the private comp set or follow-on fundraising benchmarks would strengthen conviction in this range. Key uncertainties include the company's revenue traction, capital efficiency relative to stated peers, and market timing for next-stage fundraising, none of which are detailed in available data. The $14M median represents a reasonable interim view pending deeper operational diligence.
